about: The small Pac-Man maze (T97): the board, where everyone starts, and the four pellets. Read by Python from a byte-for-byte copy in the package (python/gameaikit/maze/maze.json) and by Godot from another (godot/game/maze/maze.json); tests hold both to this file (ADR 0007). A cell is [column, row], column 0 on the left and row 0 at the top, so up is row - 1. In `rows`, # is a wall and every other character is floor. 52 floor cells, no dead end, eight intersections. A ghost's `corner` is its scatter target, outside the walls as in the arcade, so a ghost in scatter never reaches it and circles the nearest block instead (Blinky top right, Pinky top left).
